items.title: Recursion CEO details novel Phase III endpoint for rare disease drug
items.summary: The AI-driven biotech has secured FDA alignment on a pivotal trial for its FAP therapy, with a study start planned for 2027.

items.title: Geopolitical pressures and greater buyer selectivity hamper M&A deal closure rates
items.summary: Despite substantial M&A activity and capital availability, some companies are struggling to get deals over the line.

items.title: Ellipses Pharma plots London listing that could end British biotech IPO drought
items.summary: The oncology biotech could go public in a SPAC reverse takeover, though an IPO is not guaranteed.

items.title: Lineage enters race to Huntington’s market with NeuroAirmid takeover
items.summary: Lineage hopes that hNSC-01, a novel cell therapy, could offer symptomatic and disease-slowing benefits in Huntington’s.

items.title: AbbVie and Disco ink $2.5bn pact for next-generation cancer bispecifics
items.summary: The drugs developed through AbbVie and Disco's collaboration will look to address significant unmet needs plaguing the solid tumour space.
